name: Defensive sleeve
notes: Trades from 2021 (~5 years). Defensive book: long-duration Treasuries (TLT), gold (GLD), core equity (SPY) and aggregate bonds (AGG), rebalanced quarterly. Linked to the official defensive and risk-parity sleeves.

constraints: Defensive multi-asset; quarterly rebalance; SPY benchmark; 10bp cost.
